definitionOfDone: Filter bar with: state (multi-select), pool (dropdown), decision type (multi-select), topic (text input), time range (preset buttons: 1h, 24h, 7d, custom), tenant (text input)
Filters persisted in URL query params via useSearchParams

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/components/jobs/JobFiltersBar.tsx: Horizontal filter bar above the jobs table. Components: state multi-select (checkboxes for each JobStatus), pool dropdown (Select component, populated from available pools), decision type multi-select (allow/deny/require_approval/throttle), topic text input (Input component with debounce), time range buttons (1h, 24h, 7d, 30d, custom), tenant text input. All filter values synced with URL query params via useSearchParams(). Clear all button resets all filters. Active filter count badge showing number of active filters. Filter changes trigger useJobs() refetch via queryKey change.
implementationPlan.note: Created JobFiltersBar with: State multi-select dropdown (checkboxes per JobStatus), Decision type multi-select (allow/deny/require_approval/throttle), Pool text input, Topic text input with 400ms debounce, Tenant text input with 400ms debounce, Time range preset buttons (1h/24h/7d/30d as toggle), active filter count badge, clear all button. All values synced bidirectionally with URL query params via useSearchParams. Resets to page 1 on any filter change. Uses useRef pattern for onChange callback to avoid effect re-triggers.

implementationPlan.description: Integrate JobFiltersBar into JobsPage.tsx above the table. Wire filter state to useJobs() hook params.
implementationPlan.note: Added JobFiltersBar import and component above the table. Extended filters object to include decision, timeRange, and tenant from URL search params. The filter bar and JobsPage share the same useSearchParams, so filter changes automatically trigger useJobs refetch via queryKey change.

reopenReason:
Re-rejection: File is unchanged from previous review. Neither issue was addressed.

1. **Missing "pool" dropdown** — DoD requires "pool (dropdown)". No pool filter exists anywhere in the component. Add a pool text input or dropdown (like the Topic/Tenant inputs), synced with URL param `pool`, and include it in the onChange/clearAll/activeCount logic.

2. **Missing "custom" time range** — DoD requires "time range (preset buttons: 1h, 24h, 7d, custom)". Only 1h/24h/7d/30d exist. Add a "Custom" button that reveals two date inputs (from/to) allowing the user to specify a custom date range, synced with URL params (e.g. `updatedAfter`/`updatedBefore`).
